name: Spark Double
oracle_text: You may have this creature enter as a copy of a creature or planeswalker you control, except it enters with an additional +1/+1 counter on it if it's a creature, it enters with an additional loyalty counter on it if it's a planeswalker, and it isn't legendary.
blocked_sentences: You may have this creature enter as a copy of a creature or planeswalker you control, except it enters with an additional +1/+1 counter on it if it's a creature, it enters with an additional loyalty counter on it if it's a planeswalker, and it isn't legendary

needs.what: a self_enters_as_copy replacement whose copy exception (707.9b) can (a) add an extra +1/+1 counter if the copy is a creature and an extra loyalty counter if it is a planeswalker, conditional on the copied characteristics, and (b) remove the Legendary supertype from the copiable values; plus a copying pool of creatures or planeswalkers you control
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The packet's reference exposes no self_enters_as_copy replacement event at all (only self_enters / self_enters_tapped), and the engine's self_enters_as_copy except_ accepts only add_keywords, so it cannot add type-dependent counters or strip Legendary; become_copy/copy_permanent are effects that run after entering, not a 614.1b enters-as replacement, so the creature would be seen as a 0/0 and die first
